name: Meguro Miyuki
source:
A girl who monitors the library.

She struggles to interact with people, so she holes herself up in the library and absorbs herself in books every day. She knows a lot of strange trivia.

[Translated from [url=http://craftwork.product.co.jp/CATALOG/adieu/chara/chara_04.html]official profile[/url].]
